name: Reinforcement Learning
description: Markov decision processes, sequential decision making in operations research (OR), modeling OR problems as MDPs, dynamic programming and linear programming, value and policy iterations methods for MDPs, value-based reinforcement learning (RL), optimization methods in AI/ML - stochastic gradient methods and mirror descent, policy-based RL, actor-critic and deep RL, multi-agent RL, data-based methods for scheduling, routing, and planning problems, recent applications in OR and advanced topics in the area.
